notes.text: Enjoys drawing and naming shapes. Likes to talk her ideas through with a partner.
Draws shapes carefully and explains angles to others.
Adds fractions well when the bottom numbers are the same. When they differ she guesses instead of finding a common bottom number.
Keeps trying when she is stuck. Asks to see a worked example first.
Finished the decimals extension task without help.
Works well in a group and explains her thinking clearly.
